rules.sentence: Hirschsprung disease is a disorder at birth that occurs when nerve cells are absent (Auerbach’s Plexus) in the muscles of the colon.
Diverticulosis is a disorder in which pockets develop in the colonic mucosa due to the weakness of the muscle layers in the colon wall.
Diverticulitis can develop if these pockets get infected or inflamed, causing abdominal pain and change in bowel movements.
